articles.title: moltis v20260818.08
articles.summary: Moltis, a new technology prioritizing security and privacy, has recently gained prominence, featuring on Hacker News. Emphasizing a "secure by design" approach, it ensures that users' keys never leave their local machines. The developer is actively soliciting user feedback to address any friction and continuously improve Moltis, aiming for an excellent and highly secure platform. This focus on local key storage and user-driven development highlights its commitment to robust data protection.
